items.note: Options 'Decreased platelet count' and 'Increased platelet count' were a mutually exclusive pair that cued the key; replaced the distractor with 'Hemoglobin above the normal range' (book lists decreased RBCs/Hgb 5-10 g/dL, p158).
Opposite pair 'Decreased platelet count' / 'Increased platelet count' cued the key; replaced distractor with hemoglobin S on electrophoresis (sickle cell finding).

Distractor 'Take aspirin for headaches' was the direct negation of keyed 'Avoid aspirin and NSAIDs' (giveaway); replaced with straight-edge razor use, wrong per the book's injury-prevention/bleeding-precaution focus (p168).
Stem asked what 'the book lists' rather than a client-centered nursing question; reworded to ask which medications the nurse should anticipate.
